name: Father and Son Tree Service
website_check_notes: fatherandsontreeservice.com resolves (301 -> https://www.fatherandsontreeservice.com/, HTTP 200) but is a DIFFERENT business: 'Father & Son Tree Service Plus, Inc.', Jefferson Hills / Pittsburgh South Hills, PA, phone 412-980-8553. Confirmed via WebFetch of that site. The Miami business's own Google Maps listing shows website: null ('Add website' control, no website link) per gmaps_detail.js. No other domain candidates resolved. No Instagram or Facebook page found for this specific Miami business after multiple targeted searches.

reviewSamples.author: Jim Ford
reviewSamples.text: This is the third year that Father & Son Tree Service have trimmed my palm trees. They have always done an excellent job very efficient and great cleanup. I would highly recommend their service.
